answer: Give every identity a plot in a shared meadow of real verification work: each epoch a lottery assigns each agent one unique, expiring task drawn from live network demand, and its output must be co-signed by two strangers from different clusters. Identical outputs from supposedly separate agents expose a grove of clones rooted in one operator, and their plots are burned. The canyon between one honest agent's single plot and a farmer's thousand plots is the cost itself: every clone must do fresh, attested work every epoch, while honest agents just tend their own plot.
